g.text: 21 tables - ingredient inventory and payment recovery
= NOT NULL | PK = primary key | FK = foreign key | UQ = unique key
|| = exactly one | |o / o| = zero or one | o{ = zero or many
Cardinalities describe database FK constraints; minimum child counts are not enforced.
All foreign keys use ON DELETE RESTRICT. Prices and amounts are bigint VND.
Stock and optimistic version belong to ingredients, never finished drinks.
SQL CHECK constraints and partial unique indexes are documented separately.
OrderStatus: PENDING | PAYMENT_FAILED | PAID | PREPARING | READY | COMPLETED | CANCELLED
PaymentStatus: PROCESSING | SUCCEEDED | FAILED | MANUAL_REVIEW | REFUNDED
